vault_protocol.purpose: Sealed validation scenes: protection against overfitting the teacher or the GT-free gate to the development gate scenes. A teacher tuned (even accidentally) to the gate scenes would be silently wrong on no-GT internet video -- the exact failure the whole system exists to prevent.
rules: Vault scenes are NEVER part of config/canonical_assets.json or evaluate.CANONICAL_TRACKS.
Vault scenes are run ONLY at declared milestones (python -m atlas3r.teacher --manifest config/vault_assets.json), and every vault run is recorded in docs/ with its commit hash.

No threshold, parameter, policy, or code path may ever be tuned in response to a vault result. A vault regression is an OVERFITTING ALARM that triggers diagnosis of the development process, not a fix targeted at the vault scene.
A vault scene that gets used for tuning is burned: it must be retired from the vault and replaced.

metadata.recommended_source: TUM RGB-D freiburg3_long_office_household -- DIFFERENT camera (fr3 calibration) than every fr1 gate scene, so it also tests intrinsics generalization
